flags: Founding years: Holon sources conflict (CBS 1995 list 1933; CBS 2022 file 1940; EJ first settled 1925) - founded value left at 1933, founded_note updated; Hadera CBS 1890 vs JVL 1891; Ra'anana CBS 1921 vs EJ 1922; Kfar Saba CBS 1903 vs JVL beginnings 1892; Kiryat Malakhi CBS 1951 vs EJ 1950 (PalQuest: 1951).

Arad founded_note: dropped the unsourced claim of formal inauguration in 1962 (CBS and EJ give 1961). Dimona note softened from 'built from 1958' to 'under way by 1958' (S144 says US U-2 flights captured construction in 1958).

Pre-1948 towns: the 1948-05-14 status is supported by EJ/JVL passages giving the town's 1947/48 population or 1948-war events (existence under Israeli control is inferred, no source states 'in Israeli hands on 14 May'); Tel Aviv additionally by the Declaration issued at Tel Aviv. Quotes for Herzliya, Nahariya, Holon, Gedera use EJ variant spellings and carry covers.
Or Yehuda note rewritten from EJ (immigrants mainly from Iraq and Romania; Saqiyya and Kafr Ana villages abandoned before being taken by Israeli forces in June 1948).
unsourced: yeruham, harish: only the CBS register row found (no narrative page opened); Harish note 'Nahal outpost', 'Katzir-Harish until 2012' not sourced.
Hadera, Hod HaSharon, Petah Tikva: no source found stating a 1948 fact about the town; cites show only its existence/population/growth after 1948.
Eilat, Beit Shemesh, Modi'in, Kiryat Gat, Nof HaGalil, Mitzpe Ramon: existing cites already name the town; left unchanged.
Rosh HaAyin: EJ says ma'barah 1950, permanent 1951.
